Northern Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 6.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northern Capital Management Llc bought 3,298 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 54,812 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.20 million, up from 51,514 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northern Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.

The hedge fund held 55,000 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.44M, up from 36,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mkp Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $39.22B market cap company. It closed at $114 lastly. It is down 8.19% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.38% the S&P500.
